basics.name: Vedant Borkute
basics.summary: Data Scientist and Full-Stack Software Engineer with expertise in time-series forecasting, machine learning, and building scalable systems. Currently pursuing MS Computer Science at UC Riverside.

work.name: Data Scientist
highlights: Implemented and benchmarked statistical forecasting models (SARIMA, VAR, Facebook Prophet) and deep learning approaches (LSTMs, Temporal Convolutional Networks) for pharmaceutical supply chain nodes, achieving 90% reduction in Mean Absolute Percentage Error over baseline methods

Performed comprehensive time-series diagnostics using autocorrelation plots, stationarity tests, and residual analysis; engineered lagged and augmented data using exogenous features to enhance model predictive power
Developed end-to-end forecasting pipeline with data preprocessing, feature engineering, model selection, and Docker-based containerization for reproducible deployment
Built AI Agents for feature engineering via RAG, cross-database natural language queries with SQL/Python code generation, and automated business dashboard creation with KPIs
Performed data preparation and analysis for business usecases using optimized SQL scripts; developed comprehensive Power BI dashboards for analytics and leadership insights

presentations.name: Online Competing and Development Environment
presentations.event: IIT Bombay, Advisor: Prof. Amitabha Sanyal
presentations.description: Built and deployed a browser-based virtual Linux environment for cross-platform code compilation with Django backend and Bootstrap frontend. Added support for multiple languages (C++, Java, Python) and implemented timed online competitions with automated grading.

presentations.name: Restaurant Management System
presentations.event: IIT Bombay, Advisor: Prof. S. Sudarshan
presentations.description: Developed a full-stack React–Node.js web app with REST APIs to manage reservations, menu, orders, and billing. Created role-based dashboards and analytics tools for real-time restaurant operations and business insights.

presentations.name: Movie Recommendation System
presentations.event: IIT Bombay, Advisor: Prof. Abir De
presentations.description: Built a hybrid recommender using collaborative and content-based filtering with deep autoencoders (PyTorch). Engineered user–movie features to improve RMSE through multi-layer neural network tuning.
